name: juan-de-fuca-chart-desk
instructions: Juan de Fuca current, kelp, and correction cards.

tools.name: current_gate
tools.description: Reads the tidal current gate off Race Rocks in the Strait of Juan de Fuca
tools.text: Race Rocks current gate. Ebb 2.8 kn at 14:10. The inbound should wait.

tools.name: kelp_line
tools.description: Reads the bull kelp line along the south shore of the Strait of Juan de Fuca
tools.text: Bull kelp line sits 200 yd off Cattle Point.

tools.name: chart_correction_184
tools.description: Reads chart correction 184 for the Strait of Juan de Fuca
tools.text: Correction 184. Shift the 10 fathom curve 40 yd north of Hein Bank.

tools.name: fog_signal_ediz
tools.description: Reads the Ediz Hook fog signal card
tools.text: Ediz Hook fog signal. Blast 2 seconds, silent 18 seconds.

tools.name: pilot_station_neah
tools.description: Reads the Neah Bay pilot station watch
tools.text: Neah Bay pilot station. Cutter Makah on station until 18:00.

tools.name: dungeness_spit_range
tools.description: Reads the New Dungeness spit range lights
tools.text: Dungeness spit range. Front 28 ft, rear 55 ft. Both burning.

tools.name: protection_island_auklet
tools.description: Reads the Protection Island auklet watch count
tools.text: Protection Island. 1,200 rhinoceros auklets on the water at dusk.

tools.name: cape_flattery_swell
tools.description: Reads the Cape Flattery swell period

tools.name: heins_bank_sounding
tools.description: Reads the last sounding on Hein Bank
tools.text: Hein Bank least depth 14 ft at 48 21.2 N.
